description: This file contains an extension to the OnboardingView struct, defining its UI layout, including a custom body with multiple subviews, navigation controls, and helper functions for constructing onboarding pages and feature rows.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Defines the main view layout for the onboarding screen, including the icon, pager, navigation bar, and lifecycle modifiers.

methods.name: activePageIndex
methods.description: Calculates the current page index based on a given cursor, with clamping to valid range.

methods.name: reconcilePageForModeChange
methods.description: Adjusts the current page when the mode changes, ensuring it points to the closest valid page.

methods.name: onboardingPage
methods.description: Constructs a scrollable onboarding page with provided content.

methods.name: onboardingCard
methods.description: Builds a styled onboarding card with optional content.

methods.name: onboardingGlassCard
methods.description: Builds a transparent, glass-like styled onboarding card with overlay and border.

methods.name: featureRow
methods.description: Creates a feature row with title, subtitle, and icon.

methods.name: featureActionRow
methods.description: Creates a feature row with an action button.

methods.name: featureRowContent
methods.description: Generates the content layout for a feature row, optionally including an action button.
